name: AI Maturity Assessor
description: Evidence-based enterprise agentic AI maturity assessment over eight weighted dimensions, 23 capabilities and five levels (Enterprise Agentic AI Maturity Model). Scores capabilities from repository artifacts and questionnaire answers, with confidence, cited evidence and human review for low-confidence items; produces gaps, a Month 1-12 roadmap and an executive report. Read-only: it never records a review.

entra.description: Microsoft Entra ID client credentials; the caller needs the Assessment.Read app role.

skills.name: Assess an organisation
skills.description: Overall level, Agentic Readiness Index, dimension and capability maturity with confidence and review status.
examples: What is the overall maturity of kestrel-bay-bank?

skills.name: Explain a capability result
skills.description: Rationale for one capability, with the evidence ids it cites and what the next level needs.
examples: Why is GR-1 at level 2 for the portfolio?

skills.name: Gap analysis
skills.description: Capabilities below target and the missing evidence per step.
examples: Which anchor capabilities are below target?

skills.name: Month 1-12 roadmap
skills.description: Prioritised steps with quick wins, dependencies, start and end months, and a backlog.
examples: Give me the quick wins for the first three months

skills.name: Human review queue
skills.description: Low-confidence or sample-answer capabilities that wait for a named reviewer.
